purpose: Source-only manual coverage checklist frozen before reading the generated graph. Diagnostic review, not an independent benchmark or question-derived gold set.

source.title: ASX set to drop as Wall Street’s September slump deepens
source.author: Stan Choe

review_rules: Derived only from this supplied article record; no questions, answers, evidence labels or generated graph were consulted.
Count distinct supported meanings, not edge quantity. A qualified fact may satisfy several rows; a combined row requires all stated participants, values and qualifications.

Graph-fact coverage requires addressable participants joined to the asserted predicate, value and conditions. Finding the wording only through the retained article counts as source-access coverage separately.
Preserve reported observations, allegations, opinions, predictions and uncertainty as distinct meanings with source attribution; retention does not independently establish truth.
Keep source dates, relative dates, currency notation and approximation as given. Do not repair conflicting chronology or fill omitted fields from outside knowledge.
Publication metadata, navigation and collection artifacts are audited separately and must not inflate domain-assertion coverage.

editorial_and_publication_meanings.meaning: Stan Choe is the supplied author; The Sydney Morning Herald is the publisher. Preserve the exact title, URL, business category and supplied publication timestamp as source metadata, not event timestamps.

The headline forecasts an ASX drop while the retained body includes Australian session results. Do not silently reconcile the headline and body into one confirmed index result or invent a missing overall ASX return.
The body uses Tuesday, Monday, February, May and about three years ago. These labels must retain their source context without replacing them with guessed exact dates.
Loading, Tweet of the day and layout labels do not assert market events; no tweet content is present.

section_coverage.meaning: Section labels organize this source; they are not independent domain facts or taxonomic is-a links.

negative_checks: Do not mark the Betashares acquisition or Star funding target as completed.
Do not add together Star's $565 million, earlier $800 million and targeted $750 million as independent completed raises; overlap and timing are not fully explained.
Do not swap Star's 60-cent low/offer price with its 63-cent session close, or lose the 16-percent decline.
Keep each company/index percentage attached to the correct entity and reporting window; distinguish session, overnight and September-to-date changes.
Do not assign USD to unqualified Australian-market dollar figures; crude quotes explicitly use USD.
Do not turn analysts' assessments, recession/inflation concerns or a threatened shutdown into established future outcomes.
Keep shutdown sample size, minimum duration, analyst and before/during/after windows joined; do not interpret historical averages as this episode's prediction.
Keep FTC allegations distinct from an adjudicated antitrust violation and preserve the seventeen-state plaintiff count.
Do not infer exact chronology or an overall ASX percentage absent from this retained article.
Keep the quoted committee-powers statement attributed to McKenzie; do not infer Joyce's location or legal status.
Generic related-to links or isolated summary Claims do not substitute for the company-to-price, person-to-employer, sample-to-statistic or plaintiff-to-allegation joins.
